description: Customer information management, maintaining customer details, updating residential addresses, identity verification for information changes, and required supporting documents.
Processing internal and external funds transfers, transfer eligibility, available balances, transaction status, failed transfers, and reversals.
Debit card operations, card issuance, activation, PIN management, lost or stolen card reporting, card blocking, replacement, and transaction restrictions.
Account security and fraud prevention, unauthorized transaction reporting, suspicious activity, customer security, and fraud-related procedures.
Opening new personal banking accounts, customer eligibility, required applicant information, identity verification, supporting documents, KYC checks, and account approval.
Loan application procedures, applicant eligibility, lending assessments, required application information, identity verification, and loan operations.
Banking fees and charges, applicable service fees, fee assessment, customer charges, and fee-related operational procedures.
Customer transaction disputes, unauthorized transactions, dispute classification, investigation, supporting evidence, and chargeback procedures.
Customer complaints, complaint submission, classification, investigation, resolution, escalation, and customer communication.
Account closure, dormant and inactive account classification, account restrictions, reactivation, and account closure procedures.
